corrections.reason: A stray ink mark on the left leg of ላ made it look like ሳ. Both visually and philologically it is ላለው ('ሊቃውንት ፡ ላለው ፡', parallel to line 9 'ነቢያት ፡ ላለው ፡ አመጣ ፡').
The final character of ልታጠፋህ is ህ with slight ink bleed at the top, not ኸ, matching the 2nd person masculine singular object suffix -ህ translating ላዕሌከ.
The third character in የበርያሱስን clearly has the top-left bend of 6th-order ር (matching በርያሱስ in Col 3 L01-02), not 1st-order ረ.
